name: NexMailPro Email Validation
author: Muhammad Golam Soroar

sections.description:
NexMailPro Email Validation helps protect your WordPress website from invalid, disposable, temporary, and risky email addresses before they enter your database.

The plugin connects securely to the NexMailPro API and provides real-time email validation for WordPress forms, WooCommerce checkout, Contact Form 7, and manual validation inside the WordPress admin.

No Laravel application code is required. The plugin communicates securely with the NexMailPro API using HTTPS.

Features include:

  • Real-time WordPress registration email validation.
  • WooCommerce checkout email validation.
  • Contact Form 7 email validation.
  • Manual single email validation.
  • Bulk validation for up to 100 email addresses per request.
  • Validation dashboard with activity metrics.
  • Validation logs with search and filters.
  • CSV export of manual validation results.
  • Configurable blocking policy.
  • Custom validation messages.
  • API connection testing.
  • Optional validation logging.
  • Optional cleanup on uninstall.

Documentation

  • Website: https://nexmailpro.com
  • Get API Key: https://nexmailpro.com/app/api-keys
  • API Documentation: https://nexmailpro.com/docs/api
  • WordPress Plugin Guide: https://nexmailpro.com/user-guide/wp-plugin
  • Privacy Policy: https://nexmailpro.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://nexmailpro.com/terms-of-service

sections.installation:
1. Upload the nexmailpro-email-validation folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate NexMailPro Email Validation.
  3. Go to NexMailPro → Settings.
  4. Enter your NexMailPro API Key.
  5. Verify the API Base URL.
  6. Configure integrations and blocking policies.
  7. Click Save Settings.
  8. Click Test API Connection.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Laravel?

No.

The plugin is completely standalone and communicates only with the NexMailPro API.

Which forms are supported?

Version 1.0 supports:

  • WordPress Registration
  • WooCommerce Checkout
  • Contact Form 7
  • Manual Validation

Additional integrations may be added in future releases.

How many emails can bulk validation process?

Up to 100 email addresses per request.

What happens if the API is unavailable?

Public forms are not blocked if the API cannot be reached.

The failure is recorded in the validation logs (if logging is enabled), allowing administrators to review the issue without interrupting user registrations or submissions.

Can plugin data be removed during uninstall?

Yes.

Enable Delete data on uninstall in Settings before uninstalling.
